name: vectrojs
description: Multi-core analytics engine for JavaScript: columnar tables, SQL and fused SIMD WebAssembly kernels for Node, browsers and edge runtimes, with no native code. Serves tables to Power BI, Tableau, Metabase, Grafana, pandas and Polars.
author: Hamza Masood
